about: One-shot launch request V5 (host-session and join-session). Valid cases parse to the listed fields, read the same in any member order, and write back to bytes exactly; invalid cases are refused. Every other launch keeps writing V4. Generated by generate_launch.py.

valid.about: A host starts a launch target, then opens it on the LAN under relay-only privacy.
A public host at the main menu: direct privacy with its consent, UPnP, any port, a password asked for in game, escapes and non-ASCII text, and a developer peer slot.
Joining an invite the control plane resolved.
Joining a LAN listing needs no service.
Joining an Internet listing, as a developer peer.
Relay-only allows a direct target on the local network.
Relay-only allows a name that resolves on the local network.
Relay-only allows a unique-local IPv6 address.
A public direct target with the player's consent to direct play; a display name with a line separator inside is written raw.

invalid.about: Passwords are typed in game, never staged.
Host options never carry the password either.
Under relay-only, a direct target beyond the local network lacks the player's consent to direct play.
Under relay-only, a name beyond the local network is never looked up.
Direct privacy requires the consent record.
Relay-only never carries a consent.
A consent covers only the session it was given for.
A consent names an acknowledged disclosure, version 1 or later.
The command agrees with the session role.
A join never carries a plan.
A join runs exactly its planned packages.
A join carries no host options.
A host carries no join target.
A host carries its options.
A join carries its target.
A join never maps a port.
An invite needs the control plane.
An Internet listing needs the control plane.
A LAN listing needs LAN discovery.
LAN visibility needs LAN discovery.
Invite-only hosting needs the control plane.
Safe mode never hosts or joins, so V5 has no safeMode.
The V5 reader takes version 5 only.
The service origin is a DNS name, never an address.
The service origin is HTTPS.
The service origin has no path.
Optional members are omitted, never null.
Display names are 2 to 24 UTF-16 code units.
Display text has no surrounding white space.
Display text has no control characters.
Hosts are written in their one canonical spelling.

A peer slot lies inside its peers.
The developer loop runs 2 to 8 peers.

The package digest covers the packages.
Sessions hold 2 to 16 players.
Sessions hold 2 to 16 players.
